captions.detailed: An adjustable decline workout bench designed for home fitness. It features a long rectangular back pad, an adjacent articulated seat pad, and a dual leg-roller assembly at the front end for leg support. The main frame is constructed from black metal tubing, supported by a rear horizontal stabilizer bar and a front wheeled assembly. Two small transport wheels are mounted on the front axle, accompanied by a curved metal carry handle extending forward from the crossmember. The back pad and seat can rotate on their respective horizontal hinges, while the leg rollers and transport wheels rotate continuously around their axles.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an adjustable decline workout bench with a black metal frame, a rear foot stabilizer, and a front wheeled base. The assembly must include an adjustable back pad and seat connected via horizontal rotational hinges, a front support post with continuous-spinning dual foam leg rollers, and a front axle with transport wheels and an integrated curved carry handle.
captions.factory: The bench is constructed by defining a base frame using Box and Cylinder primitives for the main spine, rear stabilizer, and front crossbar. A curved front handle is swept or approximated using cylinder segments, and transport wheels are modeled as thin cylinders on a front axle. The back pad and seat are created as rectangular boxes representing the cushions, attached to the spine via revolute joints. The leg-roller assembly is modeled with a central support pillar and a horizontal axle holding cylindrical foam pads, configured with continuous joints to allow rotation.
